author: cozmonat
description: Judge-model auto-approval hook for oh-my-pi (OMP) and pi-agent: one-shot risk assessment of each bash command — command plus compact session context — via the OMP @judge model role auto-approves low-risk operations and blocks everything else (fail-closed).
name: auto-approve

blockRisk.description: Minimum judge risk level that blocks; low-risk verdicts are auto-approved below this threshold.

display.description: Where approval markers appear: off (silent approvals), marker (marker line inside the tool call), both (marker + assessment-result toast). Blocked verdicts are always visible.

enabled.description: Master switch. false disables all Auto Approve interception (pass-through to the native bash tool).

fallback.description: Policy when the judge crosses the risk threshold or no usable verdict arrives: block (fail-closed default, deny without asking) or ask (a deep-analysis model re-analyzes the command — a cleared command is auto-approved, a risky one opens a dialog for the user to decide; degrades to block without a UI).
